<function name="GetBrushPlaneCount" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the amount of planes of non-nodraw brush model surfaces of the entity's model.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The amount of brush model planes of the entity's model. This will be 0 for any non-brush model.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
